title: What is Build and Release?
overview: Build and release is the process of preparing a React Native application for production and making it available to users through platforms like Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

example.title: Build Process
example.content:
Development Code
      ↓
Production Build
      ↓
App Store Release

title: Debug vs Release Build
overview: React Native provides different build modes. Debug builds are used during development with debugging features enabled, while release builds are optimized for production users.

example.title: Difference
example.content:
Debug Build:
• Development purpose
• Debug tools enabled
• Not optimized

Release Build:
• Production purpose
• Optimized performance
• Debugging disabled

title: Android Build Process
overview: Android builds are created using Gradle. React Native CLI uses Android Studio configuration and Gradle files to generate APK or AAB files.

title: Generating APK and AAB
overview: APK files are used for directly installing Android applications, while AAB files are the recommended format for publishing applications on Google Play Store.

example.title: Build Files
example.content:
APK:
• Install directly on devices

AAB:
• Used for Play Store publishing

title: App Signing
overview: App signing verifies the identity of the application developer. Android and iOS require signed applications before publishing them to their stores.

example.title: Android Signing
example.content:
Signing Process:
• Generate Keystore
• Configure Gradle
• Create Signed Build

title: Environment Configuration
overview: Production applications often require different configurations such as API URLs, keys, and environment-specific settings. Environment variables help manage these values safely.

example.title: Environment Example
example.content:
Development:
API_URL = localhost

Production:
API_URL = production-server

title: Publishing Application
overview: After creating a release build, applications can be published to app stores. Developers need to provide app details, screenshots, descriptions, and required configurations.

example.title: Publishing Steps
example.content:
1. Create release build
2. Sign application
3. Upload to store
4. Submit for review

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how React Native applications are built and released, the difference between debug and release builds, Android build process, signing, configuration, and publishing applications.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:

✔ APK installs directly on devices.
✔ AAB is used for Play Store.
✔ App signing is required for publishing.
